simplelod.configuration.title: SimpleLOD Config
simplelod.configuration.lod_render_dista:
Controls the combined render distance of vanilla and LOD chunks.
Range: 8-128 chunks
simplelod.configuration.lod_color_provid:
Controls how the color of blocks in LODs is determined.
- MAP_COLOR: the color is computed from the block's map color used by vanilla maps
- PARTICLE_TEXTURE: the color is computed from the block's particle texture
- BLOCK_MODEL: the color is computed from the block's model
simplelod.configuration.force_naive_mesh: Force use of the naive mesher. Only use if the greedy meshing causes issues!
simplelod.configuration.force_naive_rend: Force use of the naive renderer. Only use if the MultiDrawIndirect renderer causes issues!
